# The deliverable templates — names only

The documents a character hands you in Meridian are modelled on seven deliverable templates. The
templates themselves are kept private; only their names are published, so that a document which
cites one can still be checked (`test/smoke.js` reads this list when the templates are not here).

- `01-discovery-notes`
- `02-recommendation-memo`
- `03-acceptance-criteria`
- `04-pilot-review`
- `05-decision-log`
- `06-process-exception-map`
- `07-answer-refuse-handoff`
